# Lemon Tracking

> Local screen and application activity tracking.

Homepage: https://lemontracking.org/
Downloads: https://lemontracking.org/download/
Documentation: https://lemontracking.org/docs/
FAQ: https://lemontracking.org/faq/

The 0.1.2 release contains a Windows x64 collector, a macOS Apple Silicon agent, a Linux x86_64 agent and an Android APK using Usage Access for current-day foreground summaries. Activity records stay on the device running the collector. Source publication status appears on the Legal Information page.
